question.text: A trading member in the F&O segment is responsible for:

answer.text: Maintaining adequate control over persons having access to the firm's user IDs and meeting its client-broker compliance duties
Allowing any employee unrestricted use of the firm's trading user IDs
Treating user-ID misuse as solely the exchange's responsibility
Ignoring user-access controls because they are not part of broker compliance

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that a trading member is responsible for maintaining adequate control over the persons having access to the firm's user IDs on the trading system. The same trading member must also discharge its client-broker compliance duties, including KYC, timely order execution, margin collection, contract notes, and complaint resolution. The Trap: Unrestricted employee access, treating misuse as only the exchange's problem, or ignoring access controls all conflict with the trading member's stated responsibility to control user IDs. Note: Anchor: trading member must keep adequate control over user-ID access on the trading system; this is the workbook duty rather than a separate sub-broker liability rule.
